title: Require Domain Module Router Binding Shape
forbids: semantic-module router files exposing helpers, operation implementations, registries, or any authority besides their singular default createDomainSubdomainRouter result
why: A semantic module router is the only runtime binding between its declared operation contracts and its implementation registry. Closing that file preserves one executable module authority without leaking operation internals.
remediate: Import createDomainSubdomainRouter from @swooper/mapgen-core/authoring, the local ./contract.js default, and the ./ops/index.js implementation registry; bind them once and default-export only that router.
message: Domain module router.ts must expose one default implementation binding only.
